title: Les papyrus de la mer Rouge I. Le « journal de Merer » (Papyrus Jarf A et B)
version: IFAO MIFAO 136, publisher extract with English Annex I translated by Colin Clement, ISBN 978-2-7247-0706-9

passages.locator: PDF pp. 2, 5–8, 16 (cover summary and Annex I)
passages.note: The edition identifies the A and B fragments as two hieratic logbooks from late in Khufu’s reign. The translation preserves daily entries about Inspector Merer’s team.
